title: 第10章 互相勾搭
content_zh:
2002年的BJ冬夜，人民大会堂外的空气里透着一股寒意，但红毯尽头的大厅内却涌动着一股前所未有的燥热。

    这是《英雄》的全球首映礼，也是中国电影人第一次用如此奢华的阵仗向世界宣告商业大片的来临。

    谷川穿着全部身家买来的西服，混在其中。

    范小胖站在香槟塔后面，看着和各种人交谈的谷川。

    她看着他刚才还侧着身子，和张艺谋以及制片人张伟评谈笑风生。

    然后，又熟练的用英文和日语，分别和几个外国人沟通，和谁都能说的上话。

    “机会。”范小胖在心里默念了一遍这个词。

    她今天穿了一件剪裁极为合体的黑色丝绒长裙，领口开得恰到好处，既不过分张扬，又在灯光流转间勾勒出年轻身体起伏的曲线。

    现在她的发展很尴尬。

    片约不断，但一直没有重量级的奖项，导致咖位不大。

    谷川是南加州大学导演系的，在国外都有人脉，是她的一个机会。

    她理了理鬓角的碎发，端起两杯香槟，踩着高跟鞋，切入了人群的外围。

    “谷导。”

    谷川闻声转过头。

    看到范小胖的那一瞬间，猛地亮了一下。

    “金锁？”

    范小胖笑了笑。

    虽然她凭借金锁这个获得了很大的国民度，但她现在并不是很下喜欢这个角色。

    范小胖笑着说道：“听说谷导是南加州大学毕业的，还和陆导合作了一部电影，准备在好莱坞上映？”

    “确实合作了一部电影，但能不能在好莱坞上映，还说不定呢。”谷川保守的说道。

    开拍之前可以大胆一点，但电影都拍完了，那就要保守一点了。

    谷川说道：“范小姐，我正在准备一部新电影，范小姐有没有兴趣。”

    “嗯？”

    范小胖一愣。

    她就是单纯的想和谷川来认识一下，打算是将来熟悉了再勾搭的。

    但没想到，刚见面就打算合作吗？

    这下让范小胖有点犹豫了。

    太轻易得到的，她有点信不过啊。
content_en:
On the BJ winter night in 2002, there was a chill in the air outside the Great Hall of the People, but there was an unprecedented heat in the hall at the end of the red carpet.

    This is the world premiere of "Hero", and it is also the first time that Chinese filmmakers have used such a luxurious array to announce the arrival of commercial blockbusters to the world.

    Tanichuan wore a suit bought with all his wealth and mingled among them.

    Fan Xiaopang stood behind the champagne tower and looked at Gu Chuan who was talking to various people.

    She saw him leaning sideways just now, chatting and laughing with Zhang Yimou and producer Zhang Weiping.

    Then, I became proficient in communicating with several foreigners in English and Japanese, and I was able to converse with everyone.

    "Opportunity." Fan Xiaopang recited the word silently in his mind.

    Today she wore a black velvet dress that fit perfectly. The neckline was just right, not too showy, and it outlined the undulating curves of her young body in the light.

    Now her development is embarrassing.

    There have been many film appointments, but there have been no heavyweight awards, resulting in a small celebrity status.

    Tanigawa majored in directing at the University of Southern California and had connections abroad, so this was an opportunity for her.

    She smoothed the broken hair on her temples, picked up two glasses of champagne, stepped on high heels, and cut into the periphery of the crowd.

    "Gu Dao."

    Tanichuan turned his head when he heard the sound.

    The moment he saw Fan Xiaopang, his eyes suddenly lit up.

    "Gold lock?"

    Fan Xiaopang smiled.

    Although she gained great national popularity with the role of Golden Lock, she doesn't like this role very much now.

    Fan Xiaopang said with a smile: "I heard that Director Gu graduated from the University of Southern California and collaborated with Director Lu on a movie that is going to be released in Hollywood?"

    "We did collaborate on a movie, but it's unclear whether it will be released in Hollywood," Tanigawa said conservatively.

    You can be a little bold before filming starts, but once the movie is finished, you have to be a little more conservative.

    Tanichuan said: "Miss Fan, I am preparing a new movie. Is Miss Fan interested?"

    "Huh?"

    Fan Xiaopang was stunned.

    She simply wanted to get acquainted with Tanichuan, and planned to hook up with him in the future once they got to know each other.

    But I didn’t expect that we were going to cooperate as soon as we met?

    This time Fan Xiaopang was a little hesitant.

    It was so easy to get, she couldn't believe it.
title_en: Chapter 10 Hooking up with each other
